basic_details.job_title: IIT Delhi Project Director Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: Indian Institute of Technology Delhi (IIT Delhi) is recruiting for 1 vacancy for the post of Project Director under advertisement number IITD/IRD/271/2026. Eligible candidates can apply by email on or before 22 October 2026 by downloading Form No. IRD/REC-4 and submitting the duly filled form with complete information regarding educational qualifications and work experience, mentioning the Advertisement Number on the subject line of the email. The appointment is on a contractual basis, with a pay of Rs. 1,94,400 - Rs. 2,53,640 per month. plus HRA @ 30%. Candidates must possess a Ph.D and M.Tec

post_wise_qualification.essential_qualification: Ph.D and M.Tech from the Top five Institutes in the NIRF Ranking of the last three years, with an outstanding academic record of a minimum CGPA of 8.0. Minimum of 15 years of experience after post-graduation, with at least 5+ years in project consulting or principal scientist roles. (Desirable: Experienced in coordinating research project activities, managing and supervising teams, and conducting inter-disciplinary research; able to carry out inductive and deductive research using both qualitative and quantitative research methods; published research in Scopus-indexed journals; outstanding communication and interpersonal skills; demonstrated ability to coordinate with senior-level stakeholders).

selection_process: Short-listed candidates will be informed for an online interview. IIT Delhi reserves the right to fix higher criteria for short-listing of eligible candidates from those satisfying advertised qualification and requirement of the project post.
